original:
अश्वमेधो हि राजेन्द्र पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम् ।
तं कृत्वा पृथिवीपालः पूतो भवति सर्वथा ॥
sanskrit:
अश्वमेधो हि राजेन्द्र पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम् ।
तं कृत्वा पृथिवीपालः पूतो भवति सर्वथा ॥
transliteration:
aśvamedho hi rājendra pāvanaḥ sarvapāpmanām |
taṃ kṛtvā pṛthivīpālaḥ pūto bhavati sarvathā ||
translation: The Ashvamedha sacrifice, O foremost of kings, purifies from all sins. Performing it, a ruler of the earth becomes cleansed in every respect.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: हे राजेन्द्र! अश्वमेध यज्ञ समस्त पापों को नष्ट करने वाला परम पावन यज्ञ है। इसे सम्पन्न कर राजा सर्वथा पवित्र हो जाता है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: हे राजा! अश्वमेध यज्ञ सर्व पापांचा नाश करणारा परम पावन यज्ञ आहे. तो पूर्ण करून राजा सर्वथा पवित्र होतो.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Ashvamedhika Parva also preserves the Anugita, Krishna's second philosophical dialogue with Arjuna clarifying the nature of Brahman.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Arjuna leads the royal steed across ancient kingdoms, reconciling ancient feuds and unifying Bharata under dharma.
